title: Grateful Dead Live at Pittsburgh Civic Arena on 1973-09-24

ai_review.summary: High‑energy Eyes > Wharf Rat Suite shines on a solid audience tape despite a muffled China → Rider patch.
ai_review.review: The show delivers strong playing with the horn‑driven Eyes > Wharf Rat Suite and an exciting China > Rider jam, while Keith Godchaux’s keys are described as “on fire.” The GEMS audience recording is generally clear and well blended, though the China‑Rider segment relies on a muffled alternate source that slightly mars an otherwise good tape.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers praise both performance and recording; only one moderate critique. Weighted assessment yields a solid 4‑star rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear, well‑blended audience capture with smooth transitions; the China → Rider jam is sourced from an alternate muffled patch that detracts slightly.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set flows well, highlighted by a horn‑rich Eyes>WRS and an energetic China>Rider jam; a weaker Half Step provides a brief dip before the stomping Greatest.

band_member_comments.Keys: Keith Godchaux is praised as “on fire,” delivering standout keyboard work throughout the show.
